findings.title: Sensitive project action lacks fresh MFA or passkey evidence
findings.evidence: restricted-data-export on dataset/raw-neuro-export has MFA age 993 minutes and passkey age Infinity minutes.
findings.action: Require fresh MFA/passkey verification before allowing the action.

findings.title: Sensitive action originates from an untrusted device
findings.evidence: Device device-new-browser-9 is not remembered/trusted for user-research-admin-17.
findings.action: Hold the action until the user completes device verification or uses a known managed device.

findings.title: New device is attempting a sensitive project action
findings.action: Require owner notification and step-up before granting project changes from a new device.

findings.title: Session geography is inconsistent with recent access
findings.evidence: Austin, US to Frankfurt, DE: 7300 km in 1.3 hours.
findings.action: Require step-up verification, revoke remembered-device trust, and notify project owners.

findings.title: Session is too old or idle for the requested action
findings.action: Refresh the session and rerun permission evaluation before project state changes.

findings.title: Project policy requires a managed device
findings.evidence: project-restricted-neuro-42 requires managed-device posture for restricted project actions.
findings.action: Use a managed device or request an explicit data-steward exception.

findings.title: Restricted project action lacks hardware-key enrollment
findings.evidence: user-research-admin-17 has no hardware-key enrollment for restricted-human-subjects.
findings.action: Enroll a hardware key before persistent elevated project administration.
